record.excerpt: A base order fires when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 … Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (−2%, −5%, −9.5%, −16%, −25%) with 1.8× size scaling per rung. … Take Profit: 3% above average entry. … Stop Loss: None — ladder allocation is the structural risk cap. … Test Period: January 1, 2024 — June 29, 2026 (~30 months). … Net Profit: +3,078.29 USDT (+3.08%) … Percent Profitable: 70.97% (44 / 62) … Profit Factor: 4.028
record.notes: RSI<28 4h entry with DCA ladder and 3% TP, no stop; explicit test period and stats. Page shows Jun 30 without year; year inferred from test period ending Jun 29 2026.

spec.claim_summary: Buy when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 and average down through a five-level ladder to take 3% above average entry with no stop-loss.
spec.untestable_reason: The heart of the strategy is a five-rung DCA averaging ladder with 1.8x scaling and take-profit from averaged entry, which the schema cannot express.
